question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer

question: How many tracks are in the catalogue?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track

question: Which country has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT Country FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers are there in each country?
gold_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) FROM Customer GROUP BY Country

question: List all media types.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM MediaType

question: What is the total revenue from all invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice

question: What is the average invoice total?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) FROM Invoice

question: What is the name of the longest track?
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many invoices were issued in 2010?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2010'

question: Which employees are Sales Support Agents?
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent'
SELECT FirstName || ' ' || LastName FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent'

question: How many tracks cost more than $0.99?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE UnitPrice > 0.99

question: How many customers have a company name recorded?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Company IS NOT NULL

question: How many invoices were billed to Germany?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = 'Germany'

question: What is the total revenue for each year?
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate), ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice GROUP BY 1

question: Which 5 artists have the most albums?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which genre has the most tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks are there in each genre?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId

question: What are the titles of the albums by AC/DC?
gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'

question: How many tracks are in the 'Grunge' playlist?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Playlist p ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Grunge'

question: Which support representative looks after the most customers?

SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the top 5 billing countries by total revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Who are the top 5 customers by total amount spent?
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many tracks are there for each media type?
gold_sql: SELECT m.Name, COUNT(*) FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId

question: What is the average track length in minutes for each genre?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds) / 60000.0, 2) FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId

question: List the full names of all customers from Brazil.

SELECT FirstName || ' ' || LastName FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

question: Which artist has the most tracks in the catalogue?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which album has the most tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY al.AlbumId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: On average, how many invoices does a customer have?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId), 2) FROM Invoice

question: How many customers does each sales support agent serve?

SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName, COUNT(*) FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId

question: Which 5 genres generate the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which artist has earned the most revenue from track sales?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which sales support agent is responsible for the most revenue from their customers?

SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which customers have spent more than $45 in total?
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId HAVING SUM(i.Total) > 45
SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId HAVING SUM(i.Total) > 45

question: How many tracks have never been purchased?

question: Which billing country has the highest average invoice total?

question: How many employees report directly to Andrew Adams?

question: What percentage of total revenue comes from customers in the USA?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN BillingCountry = 'USA' THEN Total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice

question: How many different artists have tracks in the 'Classical' playlist?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT al.ArtistId) FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId WHERE p.Name = 'Classical'

question: Which media type generates the most revenue?

question: What are the top 3 genres by number of tracks sold?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY SUM(il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which employee has the most people reporting directly to them?

SELECT m.FirstName || ' ' || m.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId GROUP BY m.EmployeeId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How much revenue did the Rock genre generate in each year?
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate), ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock' GROUP BY 1
